image_description: A modern interior staircase featuring a sleek metal bannister system. The railing consists of a continuous, rounded black handrail supported by vertical cylindrical balusters and horizontal bars. The structure follows the incline of the wooden stairs, anchored by thicker newel posts at the bottom and top. The background includes a brick column, glass partitions, and a white wall with signage.
